claims: Lester Martinez defeated Immanuwel Aleem by unanimous decision.
Lester Martinez vs. Immanuwel Aleem fight took place on Saturday, March 21, 2026.
Lester Martinez vs. Immanuwel Aleem fight took place at the National Orange Show Event Center in San Bernardino, California.
Lester Martinez captured the vacant WBC interim super middleweight title.
Lester Martinez has a record of 20-0-1 with 16 KOs.
Lester Martinez vs. Immanuwel Aleem fight was 12 rounds.
Judges scored the Lester Martinez vs. Immanuwel Aleem fight 118-110, 119-109, and 120-108.
Lester Martinez vs. Immanuwel Aleem fight was broadcast on ProBox TV.
Lester Martinez became the first world boxing titleholder from Guatemala.
Lester Martinez had a split-draw with Christian Mbilli in 2025.
Immanuwel Aleem has a record of 22-4-3.
Immanuwel Aleem had a TKO win against Demond Nicholson
